title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III

funding_references.funder_name: National Key R&D Program of China

description: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial dataset investigating the neuroprotective and neuromodulatory effects of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin-derived formulation) in Parkinson's disease patients. The study combines EEG neuroimaging with clinical assessments including motor severity ratings to evaluate treatment-related changes in brain function and symptomatology. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months after completion of the intervention period (post-intervention).
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled study with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months after completion of the intervention period (post-intervention). Motor performance was assessed using the Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale MDS UPDRS III by certified neurologists, with severity recorded as ordinal 0-4 grades.
